page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword/signature line at foot ("G" centred, "logiæ" at right is a catchword). No margin notes.

main_text.p: tem, felicius suffocavit, quàm, ex Tigurina Schola Theologica, Zuinglius, Bullingerus, Huldricus? Quis Papùmo jugulum fortius & certius petiit, quàm idem ille Romani stabuli eversor Zuinglius? Quis Socinianorum, Arianorum, Servetanorum impietates, eo tempore, majori aufu & conatu aggressus est, quàm Wolfius & Simlerus? Quis abstrufa de Prædestinatione, Providentia Dei, Cœna Domini, mysteria apertius referavit, adversariorum Sophismata clarius detexit, quàm malleus ille Heterodoxorum, ipsis Venerabilis Pontificijs, Martyr? Ad errorum investigandas Origines, an ullus unquam tanto cum successu & applausu animum appulit, quanto Hospinianus, & ante ipsum Bullingerus, cujus de hoc Themate scriptum omnium propemodum eruditorum puncta tulit? Quibus verborum elegantijs, quo argumentorum robore, & phalange, Scripturæ Sacræ authoritatem, contra temerarias & impias Cochlæi offucias, cum adversarij stupore, asseruit Bullingerus? Quanta Δεινότης & Ciceroniano plane eloquio de Ecclesia differuit Wolfius? Non obscuro de Schola Pædotribæ, sed Dudithio, Episcopo Quinquecclefiensi (quanto prius in castris Philistæis Goliatho! vix nominetenus ad tempus nostro, turpissimo verò tandem defertori, Antitrinitario) scopuli & scrupuli erant eximendi. Et cùm infelices Osiandri de justitia, Brentij & Andreæ de Ubiquitate & Prædestinatione, Illyrici de peccato Originali, aliæque plures Ecclesiam vexâssent controversiæ, quâ demonstrationum evidentiâ, figmenta illa per Ecclesiæ & Scholæ Tigurinæ Ministros fuerunt elufa & elifa, absurditâsque eorum in apricum producta? Huberus caput vix effert, Theologorum Tetrapolitanorum, quos inter erat Stuckius, judicio cadit. Doctrina Sacramentaria plus forte ex Schola Tigurina accepit lucis, quàm à me, absque suspicione tenerioris in patriam amoris, possit commemorari. Sed quid singulas Theologiæ

page.notes: Page number "45" is partly damaged; read as 4 with the final digit uncertain. The catchword "logiæ" and signature "G" are at the foot. Some words in the Greek "Δεινότης" are a reading of a damaged Greek word and may be inexact; "Huberus" and "Stuckius" read with some doubt.
